Q0_s1.explanation: The unit mainly responds to the muzzle and snout of canids (dogs, wolves, foxes), centered on the eye-to-nose region. It also responds more weakly to similar tapering facial protrusions on other animals, such as shorebird bills, badger and bear snouts, and an ox head.

parsed.explanation: The unit mainly responds to the muzzle and snout of canids (dogs, wolves, foxes), centered on the eye-to-nose region. It also responds more weakly to similar tapering facial protrusions on other animals, such as shorebird bills, badger and bear snouts, and an ox head.
parsed.evidence: Most top activations (7–10) have red boxes on dog, wolf, fox or husky muzzles, with the strongest on dogs. The weaker top hits are long sandpiper bills (#4, #12, #18) and other mammal snouts (#5, #15, #19), while random photos, including a dog and a sloth face, stay at 1–4.
parsed.missing_data: Activations on non-canid long-snouted animals and on canid faces seen front-on versus in profile would show whether it encodes canid identity or just an elongated snout shape.

F1_s1.explanation: The unit responds to a tapering, wedge-shaped protrusion that narrows to a point capped by a small dark rounded tip, usually with a small dark spot set back from it and contrasting light-dark fur-like texture around it. Weaker responses come from thinner, longer pointed forms ending in a sharp dark tip.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a tapering, wedge-shaped protrusion that narrows to a point capped by a small dark rounded tip, usually with a small dark spot set back from it and contrasting light-dark fur-like texture around it. Weaker responses come from thinner, longer pointed forms ending in a sharp dark tip.
parsed.evidence: Nearly all top-20 boxes sit on a converging pointed form with a dark terminal blob (#1-3, #6-11, #13, #15), and the long thin dark-tipped forms (#4, #12, #18) score somewhat lower at 7-8. Random photos stay at 1-4, even ones with similar textures but no clear pointed taper in profile (#2 random scored only 1).
parsed.missing_data: Synthetic or abstract stimuli with isolated dark-tipped tapering wedges, without surrounding texture, would show whether the shape alone drives the unit.
